title: The Mythical Pokémon That May Hold Every Pokémon's DNA
premise: Mew is a tiny Mythical Pokémon whose DNA may connect it to the origin story of every other Pokémon.
audiencePromise: Start with Mew's rarity and playful mystery, then land the ancestor theory and its famous link to Mewtwo.
openLoop: How can one tiny pink Mythical Pokémon be connected to nearly every Pokémon?
payoff: Mew's genetic code may hold the secrets of all Pokémon, and it later helped inspire Mewtwo.
engagementQuestion: More iconic: the mystery of Mew or the power of Mewtwo?

voice.instructions: Warm, curious Pokémon short narrator. Make Mew feel playful, elusive, and legendary. Build genuine wonder, then land the Mewtwo link with energy. Keep it crisp, conversational, and natural. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: THIS TINY POKÉMON MAY HOLD EVERY POKÉMON'S DNA
scenes.narration: This tiny Mythical Pokémon may carry the genetic code of every Pokémon.
scenes.caption: ONE TINY MON, HUGE MYSTERY

scenes.headline: SO RARE IT FELT LIKE A MIRAGE
scenes.narration: Mew is a rare Mythical Psychic Pokémon many thought did not exist.
scenes.caption: ELUSIVE • MYTHICAL • LEGENDARY

scenes.headline: IT FLOATS, PLAYS, AND CAN VANISH
scenes.narration: It floats playfully and can vanish from sight whenever it wants.
scenes.caption: PLAYFUL • FLOATING • ELUSIVE

scenes.headline: SCIENTISTS THINK IT CAME FIRST
scenes.narration: Scientists think Mew may be the ancestor of all Pokémon.
scenes.caption: ANCESTOR THEORY

scenes.headline: ITS DNA HELPED CREATE MEWTWO
scenes.narration: Its DNA later became the key to creating Mewtwo.
scenes.caption: MEW → MEWTWO

scenes.headline: PURE MYSTERY OR PURE POWER?
scenes.narration: Which is more iconic: Mew's mystery or Mewtwo's power?
scenes.caption: MEW OR MEWTWO?
